subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Perceber o princípio acrofônico que opera nos nomes das letras do alfabeto.

components.description_pt: Identificar o princípio acrofônico pelo qual nomes de letras começam com seus sons
components.description_en: Identify the acrophonic principle by which letter names begin with their corresponding sounds
components.cc_component_description: Identify the differing sounds of letters in similarly spelled words

components.description_pt: Reconhecer que o som inicial do nome de uma letra corresponde ao som que a letra representa
components.description_en: Recognize that the initial sound of a letter's name corresponds to the sound that letter represents
components.cc_component_description: Produce the primary sound for each consonant letter of the alphabet

components.description_pt: Aplicar conhecimento do princípio acrofônico para identificar letras por seus nomes
components.description_en: Apply knowledge of the acrophonic principle to identify letters by their names

cc_matches.description: Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying the sounds of the letters that differ.
Demonstrate basic knowledge of one-to-one letter-sound correspondences by producing the primary or many of the most frequent sound for each consonant.
